title: Summer Nocturnal Behavioral Surge
behavioral_explanation: Nocturnal crime activity increases by nearly 4 percentage points during peak summer months (July/August), driven by elevated outdoor evening activity, longer daylight socializing, and nightlife concentration.

title: Warm-Weather Surge in Armed Interpersonal Violence (Cluster 1)
behavioral_explanation: Cluster 1 (Violent Armed Interpersonal & Domestic Assaults) expands significantly during warm months, rising from 32.89% in winter to 34.31% in spring/summer, corroborating routine activity and temperature-aggression behavioral hypotheses.

title: Year-End Metropolitan Core Retail Theft Surge (Cluster 6)
behavioral_explanation: Metropolitan Core Retail Larceny (Cluster 6) expands systematically in the second half of the year, peaking in October through December. This reflects increased retail foot traffic, holiday merchandise exposure, and commercial shoplifting opportunities.

title: Systematic Decline in On-Scene Arrest Proportion
behavioral_explanation: The proportion of incidents culminating in immediate on-scene arrest trends downward steadily from spring (24.57%) into autumn (21.18%), likely indicating shifting police resource allocations, differing incident reporting backlogs, or changes in proactive field interdictions.
